The '''Deersheba system''' was located in the [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Great Pandemic of Deersheba]].<ref name="Phrasebook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Great Pandemic of Deersheba]]|system=Deersheba [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Deersheba [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-16.<ref name="TEA" />
